Reconnaissance.description: Behavioural evidence of discovery or probing activity.

Initial Access.description: Behavioural evidence of an elevated suspicious connection or threat signal.

Lateral Movement.description: Behavioural evidence of communication expanding across endpoints.

Command and Control.description: Behavioural evidence from available inter-arrival timing signals.

Exfiltration.description: Behavioural evidence of high-volume traffic combined with malicious-flow evidence.
